items.title: Try a 10 to 20 minute walk after dinner
items.text: Try walking after dinner to see how it affects you. Walking after dinner is linked to a rise about 18.3 mg/dL smaller in the same person.

items.title: Move dinner earlier
items.text: Try to start dinner before 8 pm. Sugar rose about 9.2 mg/dL more after late dinners than after earlier ones in the same person.

items.title: Aim for a 13-hour overnight break
items.text: Aim for a longer overnight fast, but start with small changes. Your overnight fast averaged 11.7 hours, and you can try to increase this time.
